features.title: Cross-Cloud Resource Schema Normalizer
acceptance: Normalize AWS Config, GCP Cloud Asset Inventory, and Azure Resource Graph exports into CanonicalAsset schema
Extract standardized exposure levels, network configurations, and IAM privileges

features.title: Deterministic Multi-Cloud Inventory Diff Engine
acceptance: Detect added, removed, and modified cross-cloud resources between snapshots
Identify security-relevant property drifts including exposure escalations and unowned assets

features.title: Supervised Drift Risk Severity Classifier
acceptance: Classify configuration drift into LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, and CRITICAL severity tiers
Provide offline benchmark evaluation exceeding naive rule-based baseline on macro F1

features.title: Grounded LLM Remediation Advisor
acceptance: Generate multi-cloud remediation recommendations grounded in actual diff records
Support pluggable LLM adapters with graceful offline deterministic fallback

features.title: Role-Based Access Control and OIDC Authentication
acceptance: Enforce viewer, operator, and admin role authorization across data endpoints
Provide local-only demo authentication mode while rejecting unauthenticated access

features.title: Interactive Multi-Cloud Inventory Frontend
acceptance: Visualize inventory statistics, diff deltas, and ML risk evaluation breakdowns
Support sample snapshot loading, offline benchmark viewing, and audit logs

features.title: Diff History API and Snapshot Pair Comparator
acceptance: List historical comparison runs via GET /api/diffs with pagination and snapshot filtering
Allow operators to select arbitrary base and target snapshot pairs in the UI
Validate selection against identical snapshots and render recent comparison history

features.title: Real-Time Cloud Inventory Webhook Ingestion
acceptance: Receive asset change notifications via HMAC-authenticated webhook
Trigger automated diff calculation against the latest baseline snapshot

features.title: Open Policy Agent Rego Compliance Evaluation
acceptance: Evaluate custom Open Policy Agent Rego rules against normalized canonical assets
Surface policy compliance violations alongside ML severity classifications

features.title: Exportable Signed Compliance Audit Bundles
acceptance: Generate signed JSON-LD and CSV compliance audit report bundles
Include complete snapshot lineage, diff evidence, and reviewer approval signatures

features.title: Repair Demo Login Envelope Mapping and Role Passthrough
acceptance: Demo login forwards the selected role and username to the backend
Frontend maps the backend access_token envelope to AuthState
Authenticated session persists after demo login and authorizes API calls
